handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the INCONCLUSIVE NIST-I scalar margin of EV-SSI-59f7a2 can be converted, from committed numbers alone, into the decidable practitioner-facing object p*(w), and whether the SIGN of the margin is controlled by the corrected estimator or by an unstated memory-charging convention.
constraints: Follow experiments/EXP-SSI-697354/specification.yaml EXACTLY; it is frozen. A needed change is a new exp version, not a run-side edit.

Primary path is standard-library ONLY: numpy permitted solely as optional secondary cross-check XCHK-2; if absent, NOT_RUN with the ImportError text and no reported number changes. NO sagemath/sage/g6k/fpylll/scipy/mpmath; NO network. Any forbidden import INVALIDATES the run.
Evaluation window log2 p in [256, 768] is a HARD boundary (refused, not extrapolated). Evaluation outside the window returns ROOT_OUTSIDE_WINDOW with the direction; no numeric value is emitted.
RG-REPRODUCTION-GATE (RG-1..RG-5) is evaluated FIRST; on any failure the run emits the gate report and stops (F1 -> RUN INVALID).
Both null arms run through the IDENTICAL code path with only E(.) swapped; no separate solver. Both nulls are required by the batch handoff.

No sentence from claim_ceiling.forbidden_sentences appears anywhere; no cost number appears without its memory requirement and Heuristic-1 conditionality in the same sentence. Claim tier stays medium; this is NOT a security claim.
Exactly one run; seed 0 (deterministic, no randomness). A re-run must be byte-identical apart from timing fields.
H-SSI-7fe2bf stays proposed; no status change. C1/C2 and ML-KEM/QI security statements are not made.
deliverables: experiments/EXP-SSI-697354/runs/RUN-SSI-697354-a/ (the 12 artifact files per specification.yaml required_artifacts, plus execution_report.yaml the executor returns)
completion_gate: specification.yaml frozen values (T1 rows, T2 columns, scalars T3, per-entry laws, the two MC formulations, the window) are re-read and re-extracted; any mismatch INVALIDATES the run as input drift
RG-1..RG-5 all pass and their per-law residuals are listed in bits; the run STOPS before any curve is computed if any RG fails
XCHK-1 (the second, independently written expression path for RG-1) agrees to 1e-12
MONO-1,2,4,5 pass; MONO-3 returns a verdict or an explicit NOT_EVALUABLE(n=count), never a vacuous pass
both null arms N0 and N1 have run through the identical code path and are reported with min, max, argmin, argmax, and per-P profiles of D_null0 and D_null1 and of the locus displacement
p_star_table is complete over all 4480 main cells and the 2240 null-arm cells, with the declared categorical label wherever no numeric locus exists; the 14 declared log2 w values are all used
every emitted p* lies in [256, 768]; any root beyond the window is emitted ROOT_OUTSIDE_WINDOW with its direction and not given a numeric value

every emitted number carries its fit-window extrapolation stamp and extrapolation_ratio = P/40 in [6.4, 19.2]; non-committed P is stamped interpolated_between_committed_rows with the two bracketing T2 rows named

undefined_segments.json, input_hashes.json, and environment.json are all present; environment.json records module presence/absence for numpy, sage, g6k, fpylll, scipy, mpmath plus the no-forbidden-import assertion
cross_check_secondary.json is XCHK-2's numpy result or NOT_RUN with the ImportError text
SCOPE-A, SCOPE-B, and SCOPE-C are reported separately, each with its axis named; the adversarial corner is reported explicitly
the run manifest binds git commit, dirty flag, seed 0, environment, timing, and resources per docs/evidence-and-reproducibility.md
